patch.value: Resolve polynomial-redos code-scanning alerts by measurement

All 7 open js/polynomial-redos alerts in index.ts are either fixed (REAL) or dismissed with timing evidence (NOT EXPLOITABLE); Timing regression tests added for fixed regexes, verified red on revert; All gates pass: check, test, coverage, docstring, changelog:full, pm health --strict-exit; PR opened from fix/measure-and-close-polynomial-redos-alerts branch

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
## Polynomial-redos alert measurement results (pm-todos)

### Timing methodology
Each flagged regex was measured with an adversarial input built from CodeQL's
message (prefix + repetition pattern + trailing char to force failure). Times
measured with `process.hrtime.bigint()` at n = 1000 / 4000 / 16000 / 64000.

### Alert 1 (line 631): extractTrailing — PM_ID_COMMENT_RE + TYPE_TAG_RE
Regexes: `/\s*<!--\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+...)\s*-->\s*$/` and `/\s*\[(...)\]\s*$/`
**REAL** — O(n²) from leading `\s*` retried at every position in a whitespace run.

| n       | PM_ID_COMMENT_RE | TYPE_TAG_RE |
|---------|-------------------|-------------|
| 1000    | 1.771 ms          | 1.510 ms    |
| 4000    | 24.907 ms         | 22.986 ms   |
| 16000   | 400.877 ms        | 370.755 ms  |
| 64000   | 6853.966 ms       | 5792.223 ms |

**Fix:** Removed leading `\s*` from both regexes. The `.trim()` in
`extractTrailing` already handles whitespace. Fixed regexes are linear:
0.53 ms and 0.28 ms at n=64000.

### Alert 3 (line 756): HEADER_RE
Regex: `/^(#{1,6})\s+(.+?)\s*#*$/`
**REAL** — O(n²) from lazy `(.+?)` extending one char at a time while `\s*#*$`
backtracks. Adversarial input: `## ` + `  `.repeat(n) + `#` + `  `.repeat(n) + `!`

| n       | Original   | Fixed    |
|---------|------------|----------|
| 1000    | 13.083 ms  | 0.118 ms |
| 4000    | 223.918 ms | 0.037 ms |
| 16000   | 3335.742 ms| 0.130 ms |
| 64000   | 52855.357 ms| 0.488 ms|

**Fix:** Changed `(.+?)\s*#*$` to `(.+)$`. Trailing `#` stripping moved to
code: `header[2].replace(/#*$/, "").trim()`.

### Alert 2 (line 731): sectionToTag
Regex: `/[^a-z0-9]+/g` then `/^-+|-+$/g`
**NOT EXPLOITABLE** — flat/linear, 0.654 ms at n=256000.

### Alerts 4–7 (lines 998–1018): parseTodoTxtLine
Regexes: `/^x\s+(.*)$/`, `/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s+(.*)$/`, `/^\(([A-Z])\)\s+(.*)$/`
**NOT EXPLOITABLE** — `^`-anchored + `(.*)$` always succeeds, no backtracking.
All under 0.7 ms at n=64000.

| n       | Alert 2  | Alert 4 | Alert 5 | Alert 6 | Alert 7 |
|---------|----------|---------|---------|---------|---------|
| 1000    | 0.131 ms | 0.073 ms| 0.102 ms| 0.068 ms| 0.007 ms|
| 4000    | 0.018 ms | 0.011 ms| 0.014 ms| 0.018 ms| 0.017 ms|
| 16000   | 0.045 ms | 0.034 ms| 0.053 ms| 0.060 ms| 0.058 ms|
| 64000   | 4.702 ms | 0.690 ms| 0.255 ms| 0.251 ms| 0.259 ms|

### Revert proof
Restored old regexes, ran timing tests: all 3 failed (HEADER_RE took 56494 ms).
Restored fix: all 3 passed (< 11 ms). Confirmed red-on-revert, green-on-fix.

patch.value: All 7 alerts resolved: 3 REAL (PM_ID_COMMENT_RE, TYPE_TAG_RE, HEADER_RE) fixed with linear regexes, 5 NOT EXPLOITABLE dismissed with timing evidence. Timing regression tests added and verified red-on-revert.
